verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own docs directly promise exactly this capability (Workers AI: 'Run AI inference globally with one API call... no GPUs to manage, no capacity planning'), and the broader Workers platform is well-corroborated by community praise for ease and speed. However, no community/hands-on evidence specifically validates the AI inference product's quality or reliability, and one community comment flags Cloudflare's newer AI-related docs as possibly 'AI slop', creating some doubt.
